title: Technique Innovations Terminating Illegal Wildlife Trade

tasks: Task 1: Score clients across power/resources/interests via EWM+AHP
Task 2: Assess win-win benefits via affine mapping
Task 3: Identify partner via complement vector + cosine similarity
Task 4: Predict 5-year impact via multiple linear regression
Task 5: Assess probability via five-point estimation + sensitivity

Background, problem restatement, assumptions, data preprocessing

contributions.summary: Client Triangle Profile: EWM+AHP scoring across 452 entities in 3 categories.
Win-Win Model: affine mapping from Apple case to estimate LVMH profit ($128.06M).
Complement Vector + cosine similarity for strategic partner matching (99.9% to Seychelles).
Multiple linear regression impact model (R2=0.979) with five-point probability (87.2%).

assumptions.summary: Power, resources, interests are all related to combating IWT.
Different client categories have different meanings for each dimension.
New technologies allow traditional industries to be upgraded.
Clients are rational and can be persuaded by potential gains.
Illegal trade is roughly proportional to related industry size.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Missing data handled via mean complement, kindred complement, fitting complement.

models.summary: CTP: Client Triangle Profile with EWM+AHP.
COMP: Complement Vector with cosine similarity matching.
MLR: Multiple linear regression impact model.

verification.summary: Sensitivity: +-5% variation -> 0.047% trade change, strong robustness.

results_trace.summary: LVMH selected: highest enterprise score 0.4157 among 157 enterprises.
Estimated additional profit for LVMH: $128.06 million via affine mapping from Apple.
Seychelles government matched at 99.9% cosine similarity as strategic partner.
Trade volume predicted to decrease to $17.54B by 2027, a 33.81% decrease.
Project success probability: 87.2% via five-point estimation.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Enterprise client selection (LVMH) is surprising and innovative for F-type problem.
Cosine similarity partner matching at 99.9% demonstrates quantitative rigor.
R2=0.979 with SPSS validation demonstrates statistical sophistication.

weaknesses.summary: Predictive modeling relies on accurate data; changes in factors could affect reliability.
Only 8 data points (2015-2022) for regression with 5 independent variables.
High VIF values (4.65-14.175) suggest multicollinearity issues.

independent_extensions.summary: Extend cosine matching to multi-partner coalition optimization.
Replace linear regression with nonlinear models to handle multicollinearity.
